game_title: Fallback: Door Defense – Torchlit Cave Mouth
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the knight must hold off zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the wooden door while the while-loop condition stays true and zombies keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Push to repair the wooden door while the while-loop condition stays true and zombies keep attacking. Then check door_health and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wooden door from zombies in Torchlit Cave Mouth: keep door_health above zero until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Door Defense
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 4, Level 1, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
